Cash Bid History
The Site
Elite Octane chose the site near Atlantic, IA based on the amount of work that had already been completed by entrepreneurs back in 2006. To learn more, click here.
Join Our Team
Elite Octane is now accepting applications for numerous positions and it is expected that nearly 50 people will constitute the team in Atlantic, IA. Please click here to go to our job board and learn more.
E15 & Beyond
We are all creatures of habit, particularly where we fuel our vehicles week in and week out. Did you know that a national movement is underway at fuel retailers to provide consumers a lower cost, higher-octane fuel choice? Click here to learn more.
The Plant
Elite Octane, LLC is a privately held company that constructed a dry mill ethanol plant near Atlantic, Iowa. It commenced operations in July of 2018. Learn more about our plant.
